description: Generate a motion-graphics ANIMATION from a brief — a branded intro / logo reveal / kinetic-typography sting, or a product demo. It becomes a self-contained, auto-playing motion page (timeline JSX). Optionally GROUND it on an existing project (`source_project_id` — its pages render to REAL screenshots that animate into the video), a logo (`source_logo_id`), and/or a live URL. Pick the canvas with `format` (YouTube 16:9, Reels/Shorts/TikTok 9:16, square, 4:5). A DEMO can add production layers, each ON DEMAND and billed at its real cost — leave them off unless the user asks: `voiceover` (a narrated script; scenes are timed to it), `music: "generated"` (a composed track instead of the free ambient bed) and `ai_clip` (Veo or Omni b-roll under the hook — by far the costliest, ~60–120 coins, and adds minutes). Async (~1–4 min, up to ~10 with an AI clip); the result preview_url plays it, and the preview page's Export menu downloads an MP4 in any format.

ai_clip.description: DEMO only, on demand and EXPENSIVE (~60–120 coins, adds minutes): generate cinematic b-roll under the opening hook with Google Veo or Gemini Omni. Default none — only set it when the user explicitly asks for AI video.

brand_kit_id.description: Attach a saved brand kit (see sketchxflow_brand_kits).

captions.description: DEMO with voiceover: burn the narration in as captions (default true).

demo.description: Set true for a PRODUCT DEMO VIDEO: the attached screenshots (from source_project_id pages / source_url / images) are VISION-UNDERSTOOD and turned into a multi-scene demo (hook → feature scenes with real screenshots + callouts → CTA). Best paired with source_project_id. Defaults to a short ~12s demo.

duration.description: Length in seconds (3–15, default 6; a demo allows up to 20 and defaults to 12).

format.description: Canvas. 16x9 = YouTube/web (default); 9x16 = Reels, Shorts, TikTok; 1x1 = square feed post; 4x5 = Instagram/Facebook feed portrait.

model.description: Optional. Pin which LLM generates this — a PAID-PLAN feature (Starter and above). OMIT IT unless the user asked for a specific model: omitting uses the account's default (gemini-3-flash-preview) and is the normal path. Passing it on a free plan fails the call. Valid ids: gemini-3-flash-preview (default — balanced quality and speed); gemini-3.1-flash-lite (fastest and cheapest; good for quick edits); gemini-3.5-flash-lite (lite tier, slightly stronger than 3.1 lite); gemini-3.7-flash (strongest layout/code quality per coin); gemini-3.6-flash (previous Flash generation; pin for consistency); gemini-3.5-flash (older Flash tier; costs more than 3.7 for less); gemini-3.1-pro-preview (most capable, 2M context; slowest and priciest). Stronger models cost more coins. Affects text generation only — never AI images.

music.description: DEMO only. ambient (default) = a free procedural bed that plays in the browser only; generated = a composed instrumental track, on demand (extra cost), also mixed into MP4 exports; none = silent.

prompt.description: The animation brief — what it's for, the message/vibe, what to highlight.

source_logo_id.description: Feature one of your created logos in the animation.

source_project_id.description: Ground on this existing project — its pages render to real screenshots that animate in (great for product demos).

source_url.description: A live product URL to screenshot and feature.

style.description: DEMO feel. calm (default) = a confident, unhurried keynote. hype = a supercharged launch trailer — punchy 2-3 beat script, fast cuts, flashes and punch-ins, a driving track — for energy-drink-style or 'fastest AI' products.

video_model.description: DEMO with ai_clip: which video model films the clip. veo-fast (default, ~120 coins/8s), veo (highest quality, ~320), omni (~80), veo-lite (cheapest, ~40). Only set when the user asks for a specific model or quality.

voice.description: DEMO with voiceover: the narrator voice — one of Sulafat (warm), Algieba (smooth), Charon (informative), Kore (firm), Puck (upbeat), Fenrir (excitable), Achernar (soft), Leda (youthful). Default: matched to the tone.

voiceover.description: DEMO only, on demand (small extra cost): narrate the video with a script written for the product. Scenes are timed to the voice, so the final length follows the narration.

name: sketchxflow_create_animation
title: Generate an animation / product-demo video
